## D — Accuracy and evidence notes: license eligibility and identity
Every knowledge statement for license eligibility and identity is tied to one physical page of the registered Delaware handbook snapshot. No outside legal explanation or inferred exception is added.
The first-time applicant scope excludes historical federal-security background, renewal conversion fees and vehicle-tax notes. Named immigration-category catalogs and detailed document form codes require a source-quality follow-up; core eligibility and required-document conditions are retained.
The source contains garbled identity labels and a Social Security proof line reading full SSA. These are not repaired by guesswork. The changeable consular-country list and service prices/links are withheld pending current confirmation.
Open source limitation (verify DE-IDENTITY-TEXT): Physical pages in the identity-document list contain questionable labels Northern Marina Card, Temporary Resident Identification Card K-688 and full SSA; exact document-code and SSA wording requires issuer clarification before assertion.
Open source limitation (verify DE-IDENTITY-DYNAMIC): The accepted consular-card country list is explicitly subject to change; appointment-provider links, processing fees and country-list currency require current official confirmation before learner use.
Open source limitation (verify DE-IDENTITY-CATALOG): The detailed immigration-category and document-code catalogs are not transcribed into this first-time curriculum; source-quality review and a complete applicability map are required before any claim of exhaustive document eligibility guidance.
Source quality: official issuer PDF. Extraction is text only; graphical content does not become a fact unless its supporting meaning is stated in the text. Unknown exam metadata and market evidence remain typed debt.
